contracts_checked: Only MetadataError gains fixed stage labels and an allowlisted subset of accumulated evidence. The exception is re-raised into the existing failure path.
Initial receipt rejection has its own stage and no process evidence. Subsequent labels distinguish compile, link, native, final receipt, final generator, final receipt-file check and fixed admission.

The copied top-level keys are only compile/link/native records and generated_object/generated_executable hashes and sizes. No case verdicts, source, command argv, receipt contents or retained native stdout are copied.

The inspected guard returns metrics separately from retained stdout. Its metrics contain counters, hashes, timestamps/durations, booleans, exit status and fixed/class-only reason labels, not compiler diagnostics or generated material.
The existing direct_harness_failed status, exit code 1 and no_runtime_verdict_accepted=true remain unchanged; completed process records cannot grant native or finding acceptance.
The memfd close finally block, exception propagation, guard cleanup, source/receipt checks and all compile/link/native commands remain unchanged.
limitations: Stage labels identify the phase where a MetadataError was raised; a stage label alone does not prove that the process started or completed. Process evidence must be inspected separately.
OSError, JSON/ValueError and other existing outer error paths do not gain this stage annotation. This patch is intentionally scoped to MetadataError.
No past failure is reclassified and no previous compile/link/native success is inferred.
No compilation, native execution or mock suite was run; the source-level evidence schema still requires actual execution validation.
